name: Niagara County, NY
findings: Niagara County has 605 nonprofit organizations. 298 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 241 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Niagara County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Arts and cultural organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 18 arts and cultural organizations here list membership, compared with about 8 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do arts and cultural organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Few education organizations list membership
observations.text: 4 education organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 12 would.

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through education groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 39 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 39 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
